Fail release dry run on a grep error and state lazy-fetch failure (#297)

The header of tools/release-dry-run.sh now states that, with lazy
fetching turned off, a git call of the dry run that needs an object
missing from a partial clone, such as the git show that reads the
version at HEAD, fails the run where a fetch would have let it go on
(TODO 314).

The 7 searches of step 4 for a text that must be absent, 3 in each of
the 2 pages and 1 in site-src/site.json, now run through 4 calls of a
new function, assert_lacks, which fails the run on a match and on any
grep exit status other than 0 or 1. Before, grep exit 2 was read as no
match and the run went on, against the header's rule that a tool that
fails ends the run unless the script handles that outcome (TODO 315).

tools/test-release-dry-run-refs.py gains the grep case, which makes a
grep stand-in exit 2 on each of those 7 searches in turn and requires
the run to fail there with the script's message; the docstring states
it. Its skip message for a missing .github/squash/290.txt now names
every check it skips, as the sibling message does (TODO 316).

Its text case now compares PR-BODY.md and SQUASH-MSG at the top of the
repository only when SQUASH-MSG ends its subject with (#290), as they
are then the texts of PR 290; otherwise it skips each with a message
that names every check it skips, so a review export of a later pull
request no longer fails it. The new export case pins this and fails
without the change.

The searches for a text that must be present, assert_contains, the
residual paragraph of the test and the messages the run fails with on a
match are deliberately unchanged.

.github/squash/297.txt holds this squash message.

Checks, each run from the repository root:

python3 -I tools/test-release-dry-run-refs.py exits 0 with
"Ran 76 tests" and "OK (skipped=2)".

bash -n tools/release-dry-run.sh exits 0.

python3 -I tools/test-run-all-checks.py exits 0 and prints:

    OK: 19 workflows, 84 run steps, 73 command lines in
    tools/run_all_checks.sh, 10 behaviour cases, 17 reading cases

With the script change reverted, the grep case fails in all 7 subtests,
since the run passes with exit 0.
